definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes use a long, flexible pole to vault over a high bar.

examples.japanese: {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びは{難|むずか}しい{競技|きょうぎ}だ。
examples.english: Pole vault is a difficult event.

examples.japanese: {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びで{六|ろく}メートルを{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: He cleared six meters in pole vault.

examples.japanese: {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びは{陸上競技|りくじょうきょうぎ}の{花形|はながた}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Pole vault is one of the highlights of track and field.

notes:
A {陸上競技|りくじょうきょうぎ} (track and field) event where athletes vault over a crossbar using a long flexible pole.

COMPOUND: {棒|ぼう} (pole) + {高跳|たかと}び (high jump)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びの{選手|せんしゅ}: pole vaulter
- {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びで{記録|きろく}を{出|だ}す: to set a record in pole vault
- バーを{越|こ}える: to clear the bar
- {棒高跳|ぼうたかと}びの{世界記録|せかいきろく}: pole vault world record

TECHNICAL TERMS:
- ポール: pole
- バー: crossbar
- {踏|ふ}み{切|き}り: takeoff
- {助走|じょそう}: approach run

RELATED WORDS:
- {走|はし}り{高跳|たかと}び: high jump
- {走|はし}り{幅跳|はばと}び: long jump
